name: all-starts-mixed
description: No start location, six players of every controller (user 0 and 7, computer 1, neutral 2, rescuable 3, controller 0 for 5; make-melee-valid.mjs ns-mixed): the editor's save gives each one a start at a random valid place of the playable map (the w3i's start the drawn point, within 32 of it); Studio's the valid place nearest to the w3i's start (meleesave.ts newStartPlaces). Positions ignored (random); the users' ally masks (0 and 7 each other's High) compared; Studio's eval checks the starts: one per w3i player, on the 64 grid, squares inside the playable map and apart, the w3i's starts on them (branch all-starts) The editor counts the added starts as an edit (saves 1 to 2; Studio's save never counts) and writes hit points and mana 0 on them (its next save -1, which Studio's writes at once: owner.ts savedUnitValues): expected differences

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.commands.execute('workbench.save'); await w3Workbench.settled(); const units = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText('map/war3mapUnits.doo.json')).units; const w3i = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText('map/war3map.w3i.json')); const w3e = await w3.workspace.readText('map/war3map.w3e.txt'); const line = (k) => w3e.split('\n').find((l) => l.startsWith(k + ' ')).split(' ').slice(1).map(Number); const [W, H] = line('corners'), [ox, oy] = line('offset'), c = w3i.cameraComplements; const play = [ox + c[0] * 128, ox + (W - 1 - c[1]) * 128, oy + c[2] * 128, oy + (H - 1 - c[3]) * 128]; const starts = units.filter((u) => u.id === 'sloc'), mines = units.filter((u) => u.id === 'ngol'), bad = []; const ids = w3i.players.map((p) => p.id).sort((a, b) => a - b); if (JSON.stringify(starts.map((u) => u.player).sort((a, b) => a - b)) !== JSON.stringify(ids)) bad.push(`start players ${starts.map((u) => u.player)} against the w3i's ${ids}`); for (const u of starts) { const [x, y] = u.position; if (x % 64 || y % 64) bad.push(`${x},${y} off the 64 grid`); if (x - 256 < play[0] || x + 256 > play[1] || y - 256 < play[2] || y + 256 > play[3]) bad.push(`${x},${y}: its square leaves the playable map ${play}`); for (const o of starts) if (o !== u && Math.max(Math.abs(o.position[0] - x), Math.abs(o.position[1] - y)) < 512) bad.push(`${x},${y} overlaps ${o.position}`); for (const m of mines) if (Math.hypot(m.position[0] - x, m.position[1] - y) < 750) bad.push(`${x},${y} within 750 of the mine at ${m.position}`); const p = w3i.players.find((q) => q.id === u.player); if (!p || p.start[0] !== x || p.start[1] !== y) bad.push(`player ${u.player}'s w3i start ${p?.start} isn't its start location ${x},${y}`); } if (bad.length) throw new Error(`the added start locations (newStartPlaces): ${bad.join('; ')}`);
